reliability.note: Reliability SHOULD correlate with model entropy -- that is the mechanism by which it lowers sender-model uncertainty. It must not be confounded with evidence count, scene size or eps, which are held constant by design.

INTRINSIC_COUPLING.finding: Model uncertainty and task uncertainty are causally coupled in this substrate: task entropy is a deterministic function of the model posterior.
INTRINSIC_COUPLING.interpretation: The TASK lever is clean: varying n_visible moves task entropy by 0.71-1.14 bits while moving model entropy by <=0.10 bits. The MODEL lever is intrinsically impure because task uncertainty is computed FROM the model posterior.
INTRINSIC_COUPLING.required_design_response: Model effects must be estimated WITHIN task-entropy strata (§18 stratification-first), not from pure factorial contrasts. Reporting the model contrast without conditioning would be a marginal-confounding error.
